selection_method: Uncovered selected genes in the leading scavenger-receptor pathway from the documented public MAYO AD input at gene FDR <=0.05 and absolute log2FC >=1. This prioritizes library coverage, not AD causality or pathway activity. Uploaded expression values are not imported.

hgnc_source.attribution: HGNC (RRID:SCR_002827), approved Ensembl cross-references; gene-tidy mirror reports source date 2026-06-20. Not verified against the official archive.

reactome_source.attribution: Reactome annotation data, mirrored by Computational Epigenetics / MrBiomics; exact upstream release unknown.

limitations: Extraction is reproducible, not a live API request or scientific approval.
HGNC identity cross-references do not measure expression, translation or disease association.
Reactome memberships are gene-level annotations from a pinned mirror of unknown upstream release. They do not identify molecular states, direct physical binding or pathway activity.
Any displayed scientific record requires a separate, source-checked snapshot diff. No claims, review attestations or graph changes are generated.
